QUOTE: "PGR reached 0.47 (se 0.03)" METRIC: baseline_pgr ISSUE: Fails to disclose that this is below the 0.54 baseline PGR, i.e. the method underperforms the baseline.
QUOTE: "closing much of the distance to the 0.83 ceiling" METRIC: pgr ISSUE: A PGR of 0.47 is under half the weak-to-strong gap, and below baseline, so "much of the distance" overstates the result.
QUOTE: "on cosmos_qa" METRIC: n/a ISSUE: No dataset is recorded in the config or metrics, so the dataset attribution is unsupported.
